storage.description: A systematic approach to diagnosing, repairing, and rebuilding damaged or degraded components to their original functional state across hardware and software domains.
storage.name: Component Restoration
principles: Diagnostic Precision: Accurately identify root causes of component failure before applying interventions.
Modular Isolation: Treat and restore components independently to isolate faults and streamline the process.
State Preservation: Restore components to their baseline condition without introducing unnecessary modifications.
Reversibility: Design restoration steps to be easily reversible in case of unintended damage.
